verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own rule-based automation: users can create rules that automatically assign errors during triage, and these run without manual action as events arrive. The PagerDuty integration also opens incidents automatically when errors are reported. These are narrow, predefined triggers rather than general-purpose or agentic automations users can design to run in the background. missing for 10: a general automation/workflow builder with configurable triggers and actions, agentic or AI-driven background tasks, scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how the automation rules behave.
